dashboard.description: vocus.cc 技術 SEO 倉儲。三條每小時／每日自動寫入的管線：Core Web Vitals、Google 搜尋成效、爬蟲與 AI bot。資料源走唯讀角色 seo_dashboard_ro，只有六張表的 SELECT 權限。

panels.description: 這一格是整張儀表板存在的理由。管線停掉時不會有人來通知——只有這裡的「距今小時」會慢慢變大。2026-08 曾有一條管線停了三天沒人發現，因為它的告警住在那支從未被執行的檔案裡。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT table_name AS "管線",
       max(finished_at) AS "最後成功寫入",
       round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(finished_at)))/3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "距今小時"
FROM ingestion_run WHERE status = 'success'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: 管線最後一次成功寫入

panels.description: 裝上這條管線之前，沒有人知道答案。AI 爬蟲的量長期高於 Googlebot 全家加總。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, metric, sum(request_count)::bigint AS value
FROM (
  SELECT (date::timestamp + (hour || ' hours')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS ts,
         request_count,
         CASE WHEN ua_group LIKE 'ai-%'       THEN 'AI 爬蟲'
              WHEN ua_group LIKE 'googlebot%' THEN 'Googlebot 家族'
              WHEN ua_group = 'bingbot'       THEN 'bingbot'
              WHEN ua_group = 'seo-tool-bot'  THEN 'SEO 工具'
              WHEN ua_group = 'social-bot'    THEN '社群預覽'
              ELSE '其他 bot' END AS metric
  FROM crawl_daily WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
) t
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 誰在爬 vocus.cc（每小時請求數，不含真人）

panels.description: 用具名而非分群，因為同一個分群內的行為可以差很多：ai-mixed-bot 底下 amazonbot 錯誤率 7.1%、applebot 47.7%，差 6.7 倍。當初把 ua_name 放進儲存鍵就是為了保留這個拆解能力——Loki 只留 168h，事後想重新分類已經沒有原始資料。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ua_name AS "爬蟲", sum(request_count)::bigint AS "請求數"
FROM crawl_daily WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 16

panels.title: 各爬蟲累計請求（具名，不含真人）

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_page_daily 視圖，不是底表。底表把「頁面×裝置」與「關鍵字×裝置」兩套維度存在一起，直接對底表加總會得到約兩倍的假數字，而且不報錯。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AS time,
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光"
FROM gsc_page_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Google 搜尋每日點擊與曝光

panels.description: 關鍵字維度每天被 API 的 5 萬列上限截斷（連續七天落在 47,832–48,048，波動不到 0.5%），缺的正好是長尾。所以這份排名可信，但「總共有多少關鍵字」不可信。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT query AS "關鍵字",
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光",
       round((100.0 * sum(clicks) / NULLIF(sum(impressions), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "CTR %"
FROM gsc_query_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 帶來最多點擊的關鍵字

panels.description: 刻意固定在單一維度組合（文章頁 × 行動裝置）。p75 不能跨維度重新聚合——把不同分群的 p75 平均起來會得到一個不對應任何真實使用者的數字。CLS 與 LoAF 單位不同，另外看。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour AS time, metric AS metric, p75 AS value
FROM cwv_hourly
WHERE environment = 'production' AND source = 'rum'
  AND route_type = '/article/[id]' AND device = 'mobile'
  AND metric IN ('LCP', 'INP', 'FCP', 'TTFB')
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 文章頁載入體驗 p75（行動裝置，production RUM）

panels.description: 回答「這頁零曝光是因為沒人搜，還是 Google 根本沒收錄」——這兩件事的處置完全相反，而在這條管線之前無法區分。URL is unknown to Google = Google 從沒看過這一頁。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coverage_state AS "狀態", count(*)::bigint AS "頁數"
FROM gsc_url_inspection
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Google 收錄狀態（抽樣）

panels.description: 在這條管線之前沒有人看過這個數字。applebot 有近半數請求失敗（8,499 次 404，其中 6,482 次打在 /tags）；exasearchbot 拿到的是 406 Not Acceptable——那不是找不到，是我們主動拒絕它。錯誤率高不一定要修（爬蟲本來就會試舊網址），但「不知道」與「知道且決定不修」是兩回事。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ua_name AS "爬蟲",
       sum(request_count)::bigint AS "請求數",
       round((100.0 * sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400)
              / NULLIF(sum(request_count), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "錯誤率 %"
FROM crawl_daily
WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(request_count) > 100
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: 各爬蟲的錯誤率

panels.description: /tags 是目前最大的一塊。判斷要不要處理之前，注意兩件已知的刻意決策：三個 /api/ 前綴開放檢索是刻意的、不得提議收攏；某次 PR 造成的三個 app-webview 路徑 404 也是刻意的，屬已知非 regression。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT path_prefix AS "路徑", status_code AS "狀態碼",
       sum(request_count)::bigint AS "次數"
FROM crawl_daily
WHERE ua_group <> 'human' AND status_code >= 400
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 爬蟲撞到錯誤的路徑（狀態碼 >= 400）

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_daily_totals，全站全量、與 GSC UI 同口徑（不是 gsc_page_daily／gsc_query_daily 的 top-N 抽樣）。2026-08-25 對照 GSC UI 介面數字，差異 0.00%。不可與抽樣表的加總相加。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AS time,
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光"
FROM gsc_daily_totals
WHERE search_type = 'web' AND $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 全站每日點擊與曝光（GSC UI 同口徑）

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_daily_totals，search_type='googleNews'（Google 新聞聯播），全站全量、非抽樣。position 恆為 0（無排名概念），本圖不含排名欄。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AS time,
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光"
FROM gsc_daily_totals
WHERE search_type = 'googleNews' AND $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Google 新聞（googleNews）每日曝光與點擊

panels.description: 只有全站總數（gsc_daily_totals），無 page 層——Discover API 不支援 device 維度（S2.5 已 live 證實：400 cannot be grouped by device），故只收 date-only totals。2026-08-13 官方 Discover 曝光數少記，跨該日比較時須留意。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AS time,
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光"
FROM gsc_daily_totals
WHERE search_type = 'discover' AND $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Discover 每日曝光與點擊

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_page_daily 視圖（top-N 抽樣，非全量），search_type='googleNews'。Discover 無 page 層資料（決策：只收 date-only totals），故此表僅涵蓋 googleNews。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT page AS "頁面",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光",
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊"
FROM gsc_page_daily
WHERE search_type = 'googleNews' AND $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: googleNews 曝光前 20 頁面（區間內）
